checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: Explicit RESOLVED or REJECTED prose is sufficient to close an uncertainty.
challenge_method: Construct a counterexample with syntactically valid closure prose but no retained evidence object.
Inspect v4 transition and phase evidence contracts for composition drift and duplicate enforcement.
failures_or_counterexamples_found: v4 accepts closure text without requiring a locator that resolves to evidence_inspected in the next phase.
A well-formed closure statement can therefore imply factual resolution without inspectable support.
repairs_made: Selected an additive v5 wrapper that binds repaired and rejected dispositions to next-phase evidence by locator.
Reused the phase v4 evidence validator rather than duplicating its structural rules.
remaining_uncertainty: Canonical Continuity Mining invocation of v5 is unproven.
checkpoints.evidence_quality: Direct immutable repository-file inspection; counterexample is deterministic and disposable.
checkpoints.rollback_route: Revert the v5 source hardening commit on preview.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Attempt closure using a malformed evidence object with a matching locator and claim.

checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: Locator and claim matching alone prevent unsupported closure.
challenge_method: Construct a referenced evidence object missing type, timestamp, strength, and immutability.
Probe claim substitution and lead-only evidence paths.
failures_or_counterexamples_found: The initial v5 implementation matched locator and claim but did not call validateEvidenceItem; malformed evidence could still support closure.
repairs_made: Composed validateEvidenceItem from phase validator v4 into closure validation.
Retained explicit rejection of lead-only evidence and mismatched claims.
remaining_uncertainty: The existing v5 suite does not yet contain a dedicated malformed-evidence negative control.
Evidence truth is not established merely by structural validity.
checkpoints.evidence_quality: Direct source comparison and safe fixture reasoning; runtime output absent.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Add and execute a malformed-evidence negative control at the exact preview head.

checkpoints.claim_or_design_tested: The implemented source contract is sufficient to declare Continuity Mining closure enforcement successful.
challenge_method: Re-read the exact preview files after mutation.
Separate committed source evidence from executed runtime evidence and canonical integration evidence.
failures_or_counterexamples_found: No retained Node test output exists for the exact preview commit.
No canonical command is proven to invoke v5 fail-closed.
The malformed-evidence branch is implemented but not yet covered by a committed dedicated test.
repairs_made: The claim boundary is limited to source-level hardening.
remaining_uncertainty: Runtime compatibility with existing v5 producers and consumers.
Factual adequacy of structurally valid closure evidence.
checkpoints.evidence_quality: Commit-matched source evidence; no executed test or canonical-path evidence.
checkpoints.rollback_route: Revert the evidence commit, then revert 393285cb25d06a15d3db23b919aba0d6c8053542.
checkpoints.next_falsifiable_step: Run node --test operations/continuity-mining/validateAdversarialCycle.v5.test.cjs at the exact preview head, retain stdout, stderr, exit code, runtime version, and SHA, then add the malformed-evidence fixture and prove rejection.

strongest_surviving_design: A repaired or rejected uncertainty may close only when its disposition references a structurally valid, retained next-phase evidence object whose supported claim matches the exact uncertainty and whose strength is not lead-only.
rejected_alternatives: Accept explicit closure prose without an evidence locator.
Accept locator and claim matching without validating the evidence object.
Duplicate the phase evidence schema inside the cycle validator.
Claim runtime success from committed source and fixtures.
unresolved_risks: Structurally valid evidence can still be factually weak or misleading.
v4 and earlier consumers have not been exhaustively inventoried.
next_falsifiable_step: Execute the exact v5 suite, add a malformed-evidence negative control, and prove the canonical continuity path rejects it fail-closed.
